shots.prompt: Nightmare: endless dark call-centre aisle bathed in red light, rows of empty desks with glowing red monitors stretching to infinity, ceiling lights flicker, slow ominous dolly forward down the aisle, phones' LEDs blink, eerie haze.

Andile, young Black South African man in a blue denim jacket over a grey hoodie, stands frozen behind a desk in a red-lit nightmare call centre, chest heaving with panic, eyes darting, a sudden head twitch, camera slowly pushes in, red light pulses.

Lee's giant face looms out of the darkness at the end of the aisle, a Black South African woman with braided bun and rectangular glasses, red-tinted, she slowly leans closer and narrows her eyes, glasses glint, ominous slow zoom in, light flickers.

Extreme close-up of Andile's face in red light, sweat on his brow, eyes widening in panic, breathing hard, dolly-zoom vertigo effect as the background stretches away, camera shake building, anime speed lines.

Point of view looking up from a desk in a bright modern Umhlanga office: Lee, Black South African woman in a navy suit, red tie, glasses, headphones around her neck, looks down with a teasing smirk, tilts her head, office lights glow, soft daylight from windows.

Andile dozing at his office desk, head drooping, suddenly jolts awake and sits bolt upright in shock, papers fly off the desk, Lee stands beside the desks with arms folded watching him, bright office with city windows behind, comedic anime timing.
Close-up of Andile in profile at his desk, he exhales in relief, shoulders drop, blinks, rubs the back of his neck sheepishly and turns towards his monitor, soft blurred office background.
